observed: Board-level square, column and row guides are viewport-only; row/column parameters include count, alignment/stretch type, dimensions, gutter and margin.

Rive layouts position responsive rows, columns, grids and stacks at runtime. Evir guide components remain separate authoring aids, not runtime layout containers.
